cases.title: Memex — the agent-operable harness behind MemexLab
cases.author: @btekmen
cases.summary: The reference implementation: a markdown-native vault an agent operates through five skills (ingest, markdown, query, brief, evaluate), JSON entity schemas, an eval query-set and rubric, and a declarative governance.yml that enforces a public/private boundary. Its first synthesized item distills Alex Karp's The Technological Republic into a thesis on AI and modern deterrence.
